summary: This directory manages the programmatic assembly and validation of README documentation. It provides the infrastructure to build, structure, and verify the individual content sections required for generating a project's README file.
responsibilities: Assemble distinct content segments into a unified README document
Define a standardized interface for documentation section generation
Orchestrate the sequence of section construction
Validate the structural integrity and content accuracy of generated sections
relationships: The content builder interface enforces consistency across different types of README sections.
The assembly logic executes multiple builders in sequence to produce a complete documentation structure.
Validation of documentation sections ensures that the final README accurately reflects the underlying project analysis.
designDecisions: Interface-based definition of section builders to ensure extensibility
Modular isolation of construction logic from individual section content
Sequential execution of builders for predictable document generation
Granular testing approach to validate the assembly of distinct documentation components
